title: The BYOB Challenge
heroStatement: Build something people will pay for.
heroSupport: Build a real brand with real customers.

structure.title: Goal
structure.body: Identify a customer need, develop a D2C product, and sell to real customers to generate as much revenue as possible.

structure.title: Team
structure.body: Find your own 3-member team. They are your cofounders for the next 2 months.

structure.title: Milestones
structure.body: You must meet a minimum revenue target of ₹7 lakhs. We'll provide a weekly breakdown to make it easier.

structure.title: Investment
structure.body: You can raise interest-free debt of up to ₹1.5 lakh from Mesa. This will be disbursed in multiple tranches of up to ₹35-40,000 each and tied to performance. The Investment Committee (IC) will evaluate your venture to decide on the investment and the amount. The IC will not release the funds if the deliverables do not meet the milestone targets.

structure.title: Time
structure.body: Your time starts now! You have between 1st September, 2026 and 30th October 2026 to complete the BYOB Challenge.

structure.title: What's Next
structure.body: The Challenge doesn't end when the 8 weeks are up. If your venture is working, you're free to keep building it, as a side hustle alongside your coursework, or full-time if you want to go all in. Mesa is happy to support you either way.

keyOutcome: Key outcome: revenue moves directly to your venture. What you earn from customers goes straight to your team, only the Mesa investment tranches come through the IC.
capitalNote: How this ties to capital: each tranche from Mesa is released only after the IC reviews that milestone's deliverables against the targets. Miss it, and the tranche (and your grade) are both at risk.
gainsIntro: You've joined Mesa to learn the skills, mindsets, and tools required to thrive in India's startup ecosystem. This is your opportunity to do all that as part of an intense sprint. Putting in the effort and fight to build a strong business will set you up for success for the rest of the program.

gains.title: Experience Zero to One
gains.body: You will experience what it feels like to build a business from scratch, how to identify an opportunity, set up supply chains, and execute a marketing plan. You will also learn to work with diverse teams and manage complex projects under pressure.

gains.title: Build Your Sales Muscle
gains.body: Whether you aim to be a founder or join a startup, mastering sales is the most critical skill to set you apart. Here, you will gain the knowledge and confidence to sell to your first 500 customers.

gains.title: Supercharge Your Brand
gains.body: Mesa will feature the top-performing teams across each milestone in interviews, podcasts, videos, and other assets. It's a chance to build your personal brand and put your work in front of a wide audience.

gains.title: Unlock Exclusive Experiences
gains.body: Want to grab lunch with your favorite founder? Want to head out to a top conference to pitch your idea? Top-performing teams get access to these and more during the BYOB challenge.

gains.title: Impress Startup Leaders
gains.body: At the end of BYOB, top-performing teams present their business to startup leaders. You'll get direct feedback, meet people worth knowing, and can win awards across categories tied to the milestones.

gains.title: Make Money
gains.body: You and your co-founders will keep all profits after returning investments made by Mesa. Here's your chance to own some serious cash! The revenue and profit you generate here becomes the seed capital for whatever you build next, so the harder you push now, the more runway you're building for yourself later.
gains.highlight: The revenue and profit you generate here becomes the seed capital for whatever you build next

closingNote: Previous Mesa students absolutely loved BYOB: they've shared that it is the most fulfilling experience of their time at Mesa. It allowed them to get out of their comfort zone, get close to their cohort mates, and build something that they are proud of.

watch.title: Hear from Mesa students about their BYOB experience

trancheNote: A note on all investment tranches: Tranche 2 onwards is optional, based on your need projections and performance.
milestonesIntro: Your venture must hit eight milestones across four phases before the Challenge ends. Each one is mandatory and dated, you can hit them early, but missing a deadline affects your grade, your next capital tranche, and gets escalated to your mentor and the Investment Committee.
